snippet.title: PinScape Trailer - Demo out now!
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370620/PinScape
X: https://x.com/Arkemys

PinScape is a Roguelite where you play Pinball on a board you've built yourself: place down the bumpers, the flippers, and any kind of item wherever you want.
Uncover wild interactions and powerful synergies, to chase ever-breaking scores!

Music by Alkakrab
